title: Total boundedness in U from the deformation theorem (Simon Ch. 6, 7.2, (1)–(3))
statement: Assume the following five propositions. (DF) [the frozen statement of the sibling declaration cmc_deformation_theorem] For all P, m ∈ ℕ there is c ∈ [1, ∞) such that for every ρ > 0, compact K ⊆ ℝ^P and Λ ∈ [0, ∞) there is a finite set 𝒬̂ of currents in 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) such that every IM T ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) with spt T ⊆ K, M(T) ≤ Λ and M(∂T) < ∞ admits Q ∈ 𝒬̂, R ∈ 𝒟_{m+2}(ℝ^P) and S ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) with Q, ∂Q, R IM, T − Q − S = ∂R, Q = 0 or M(Q) ≥ ρ^{m+1}, M(Q) ≤ c·M(T), M(∂Q) ≤ c·M(∂T), M(R) ≤ c·ρ·M(T), M(S) ≤ c·ρ·M(∂T), spt Q ∪ spt R ⊆ thickening(3√P·ρ, spt T) and spt ∂Q ∪ spt S ⊆ thickening(3√P·ρ, spt ∂T) (masses and products in [0, ∞], M = M_{ℝ^P}). (BR) [the second conjunct of the frozen statement of cmc_closure_and_boundary_rectifiability] For all P, d ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and every IM R ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(U) with M_V(∂R) < ∞ for every open V with closure(V) compact and contained in U, the boundary ∂R is IM. (IR) [conjunct (b) of the frozen statement of the sibling declaration cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub] For all P, n ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, every IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) in U and every Borel set E ⊆ ℝ^P, there are a current A ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and an IMRep R' in U with carrier M ∩ E, multiplicity θ and orientation ξ such that R' represents A. (IS) [conjunct (c) of the frozen statement of cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub] For all P, n ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and IM A, B ∈ 𝒟_n(U), the current A − B is IM. (ME) [the frozen statement of the sibling declaration cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure] For all P, n ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and IMRep R in U representing T: M_W(T) = R.measure(W) for every open W ⊆ ℝ^P. Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, K ⊆ U compact, Λ ∈ [0, ∞) and η ∈ (0, ∞]. Then there is a finite set 𝒬 ⊆ 𝒟_{m+1}(U) such that every integer multiplicity X ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U) with spt X ⊆ K, M(X) ≤ Λ and M(∂X) ≤ Λ admits Q ∈ 𝒬 and integer multiplicity R ∈ 𝒟_{m+2}(U), S ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U) with X − Q − S = ∂R and M(R) + M(S) ≤ η (M = M_U). Conventions: 𝒟_d(U) is the space of d-currents in U (SimonGMT GeometricCurrentOn U d) and 𝒟^d(U) the test d-forms in U (TestFormOn U d: smooth forms on ℝ^P with compact support contained in U); |α| is the Euclidean coefficient norm of a covector (covectorEuclideanNorm); M_G(X) = X.massOn G is the supremum of max(X(ω), 0) over ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x (such ω are called admissible for M_G), and M(X) = X.mass = M_U(X) for X ∈ 𝒟_d(U); spt is the support of Simon 6.2.11 (GeometricCurrentOn.support); IM means integer multiplicity (contract IsIntegerMultiplicity), an IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) is the contract structure IMRep with R.measure = θ·Hⁿ⌞M, R.action(ω) = ∫_M θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dHⁿ (⟨ω, ξ⟩ := ξ(x)(ω(x))) and R represents X when X(ω) = R.action(ω) for all test forms ω; subtraction of currents is the contract instance Sub; X ⇀ Y is WeaklyConvergesOn.
